    adj[i] = (i * k) % n

    while not visited[u]:
        visited[u] = True
        u = adj[u]

    if not visited[i]:
        mark(i)
        pairs += 1

    print(pow(n, n, MOD))
else:
    print(pow(n, pairs, MOD))
